description.narrative: The Assalaya-Sheiria-Yassin Triangle of Peace and Coexistence project aims to address identified drivers of conflict in the three localities of Assalaya, Sheiria and Yassin in East Darfur

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

3 action plans developed in the 3 localities 199 land conflicts successfully resolved by land arbitration committees 137 (32 men) households received livelihoods support TBD at evaluation - % of targeted returnees and host community households stating an increase in household income. 50 youth (43 men, 7 women) trained in vocational skills 3 sustainable and eco-friendly area-based plans designed 35% women, 15% youth, 65 % men included in the plan development process Paralegals, (43 participants 30 male 13 female including 25 youths) trained on legal aid, issues of SGBV and access to justice . 11 CBRMs functioning in Assalaya, Yassin and Sheria with a total of 220 members, (160 men and 60 women inclusive of 40 male youth and 2 women youth). 81% resolved - According to the consolidated CBRM register, they have so far received 52 cases ranging from natural resource to domestic disputes and resolved 42 cases, referred 9 cases to locality higher committee and one case refereed to native administration. 3 awareness campaigns on women rights held - 215 community members (165 women and 50 young women) were sensitized on women rights and leadership skills in collaboration with University of El Daein Faculty of Law women lecturers and a women-led civil society organization. 18 women microfinance groups established in 3 localities with 450 members (all women, inclusive of 255 young women). 2 women centers constructed in Yassin and Sheria and they are providing space for the women to do different activities such coexistence dialogues, peacebuilding meetings, microfinance savings and other livelihood initiatives.
